definitions.explanation: a fee paid regularly to belong to an organization or club
money collected from participants to cover the costs of an event like a party or dinner

examples.japanese: {年会費|ねんかいひ}は3,000{円|えん}です。
examples.english: The annual membership fee is 3,000 yen.

examples.japanese: {飲|の}み{会|かい}の{会費|かいひ}は{一人|ひとり}4,000{円|えん}です。
examples.english: The cost for the drinking party is 4,000 yen per person.

examples.japanese: {会費制|かいひせい}の{結婚式|けっこんしき}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: Fee-based wedding receptions are becoming more common.

notes:
COMPOUND:
{会|かい} (meeting, organization) + {費|ひ} (expense, fee)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年会費|ねんかいひ} - annual fee
- {月会費|げっかいひ} - monthly fee
- {入会費|にゅうかいひ} - entrance/registration fee
- {会費制|かいひせい} - fixed-fee system
- {会費|かいひ}を{集|あつ}める - to collect fees
- {会費|かいひ}を{払|はら}う - to pay fees

CULTURAL NOTE:
{会費制|かいひせい}の{結婚式|けっこんしき} (fixed-fee weddings) are an alternative to traditional Japanese weddings where guests give monetary gifts (ご{祝儀|しゅうぎ}). Each guest pays a set amount to cover their portion.
